title: S.P. Gupta v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: S.P. Gupta v. Union of India, AIR 1982 SC 149
content.holding: Relaxed the strict rule of locus standi; any member of the public acting bona fide can invoke writ jurisdiction for a public wrong.
content.relevance: Foundational charter of Public Interest Litigation in India.

evidence.note: 7-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in Writ Petition No. 273 of 1981; 1981 INSC 220; 1981 Supp SCC 87; 1982 (2) SCR 365.
